d20_guidance.routine_no_roll: automatic if prerequisites are met and failure has no meaningful consequence

design_principles: Level 1 is competent only where stats/training support it; it is not superhuman by default.
Progression increases reliability and options before raw magnitude.
Resources, fatigue, injury, time, equipment and environment remain meaningful at every level.
Enemies and the economy do not auto-scale to Jack.
Permanent gains require a defined causal mechanic; narration alone never grants stats or mastery.
High-risk abilities must have meaningful resource, contact, resistance, evidence or consequence constraints.
modifier_guardrail: Routine situational modifiers normally stay between -6 and +6 total unless a named mechanic explicitly exceeds the range.
recovery_guardrail: Recovery cannot exceed resource maxima; severe injury, illness, dehydration or starvation may reduce effective recovery.
